newsitem.title: INDIA: Eicher Motors says six month sales up.
newsitem.headline: Eicher Motors says six month sales up.

text.p: India's Eicher Motors Ltd (EML) said in a statement on Thursday it posted a 24 percent increase in sales of light commercial vehicles in the first six months to September.
"The sales of Eicher's Light Commercial Vehicles (LCVs) increased to 2,900 from 2,335 during the first half of 1995/96 (April-March)," the statement said.
It said the sales turnover in the first six months rose to 1.39 billion rupees from 1.0 billion in the same period last year.
EML, which makes light trucks, buses and special utility vehicles, is part of India's Eicher Group.

"The first half performance is particularly satisfying considering that the commercial vehicle industry grew by 12.5 percent in the first six months...," Subodh Bhargava, Group executive of Eicher said.
The statement said EML was planning to double the production capacity of its plant at Pithampur in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh to 12,000 LCVs per annum.
